title: Affine-open twist vanishing independent of proper coherence
statement: Let S be Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth], f:X -> S proper [def-weil-proper-morphism], F a quasi-coherent coherent module [pqf-def-coherent], and L invertible [def-sc-invertible-module]. Fix an affine open V of S such that L restricted to f inverse-image V is ample [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module], and assume injective resolutions of X.Modules. There is a natural-number threshold n0 such that for n >= n0 and every q > 0 the restriction to V of R^q f_*(F tensor L^n) [def-pc-derived-direct-image] is zero. This statement fixes one affine open and asserts no uniform threshold over the whole base.

source.place: Tag 02O1, Lemma 30.16.2, affine-local proof; Tag 0B5T (4), with the finite Cech cohomological-degree bound

proof.text: Restrict the proper morphism to the specified affine open V. Its base is affine Noetherian and its source locally Noetherian. Restriction preserves coherence and quasi-coherence. The hypothesis supplies the ample invertible restriction of L. Apply affine-base Serre vanishing to F restricted to this source. A finite affine cover of the quasi-compact separated source bounds all quasi-coherent cohomology by its Cech complex; take the maximum of the bounds in the finitely many positive degrees. The empty source gives threshold zero.

The affine-base comparison identifies module cohomology with sections of each higher direct image. Higher images are quasi-coherent; the affine tilde/global-sections correspondence detects the zero module from zero sections. Thus the higher images over V vanish with that threshold.

Restriction of derived direct image to V and exactness of open restriction identify these higher images with the restrictions in the conclusion. Restriction commutes with tensor products and powers; transport the vanishing along these isomorphisms. This is only a statement for one affine open; no global threshold is chosen.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_isZero_higherDirectImage_twist_on_affine_open
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian S] (f : X ⟶ S) [IsProper f]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (hF : RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace F)
    (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible]
    (V : S.Opens) (hV : IsAffineOpen V)
    (hL : ∃ h : (L.restrict (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι).IsInvertible,
      @IsAmple (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme (L.restrict (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι) h)
    [HasInjectiveResolutions X.Modules] :
    ∃ n₀ : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, n₀ ≤ n → ∀ q : ℕ, 0 < q →
      IsZero (((higherDirectImage f q).obj (F ⊗ L.tensorPow n)).restrict V.ι)
